0022600191.text: The Knicks come in at 4-4, 1-2 on the road, on a two-game winning streak, sitting 4th in the Atlantic (3.5 games back) and 7th in the East. The Cavaliers are 4-3, 3-1 at home, coming off a loss, and sit 2nd in the Central (1.5 games back) and 5th in the East. New York won the 2025-26 regular-season series 2-1 and the 2025-26 playoffs 4-0, most recently a 130-93 playoff win in Cleveland on May 25, 2026, and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27, with Josh Hart (ankle) out for the Knicks after averaging 8.6 points in 31.7 minutes per game this season.
